name: PTC Industries Ltd.
about: PTC Industries Limited manufactures and sells high-precision metal castings in India and internationally. The company offers torque tubes, airframe structural components, engine mounts, turbine frames, engine liners, swirlers, and injectors for aircraft structures and propulsion systems; turbine frames, blades, buckets, vanes, inlet and outlet structures, and bearing housings for aero engines; and airframe structures, casings, bearing housings, refueling nozzles, turbine oil tanks, and engine gear boxes for air defense, as well as other casings for land defense. It also provides pump components, valves, on-line fittings, radar structures, and propellers and propulsion components for naval platforms, as well as propellant tanks, propulsion nozzles, bulkheads, pressure bottles, and lightweight structural elements for precision-guided and long-range defense systems. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~54% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~25% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 287 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 433), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 287 vs sector median 46; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 58, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 63% a year while PE moved 189 → 287.
